cards.title: Modeling Joy After a Survival Childhood
cards.body: If your childhood was focused on survival, how do you teach your kids to embrace joy? Start with the feeling, not just activities—making room for enjoyment means making room for your authentic self.

cards.title: Kids Can Change Your Musical Taste
cards.body: Your children's music preferences might challenge your own taste—and that's okay. Parents often learn that their kids have genuine appreciation for good music, even if it's different from what defines their own generation.

cards.title: Why 'Mumsy' Is Contemptuous Toward Mothers
cards.body: The word 'mumsy' carries coded contempt, reducing mothers to 'drab' and 'old-fashioned.' We need to respect mothers instead of deriding them with dismissive language.

cards.title: Parents Should Support Kids' STEM Interests
cards.body: Parent support is critical for helping children develop and succeed in STEM. Five accessible ways can help you engage your kids in science, technology, engineering, and math.

cards.title: Youth Loneliness Linked to Smartphone Dependency
cards.body: Smartphone dependency and loneliness are reshaping how young people develop relationships. This trend has potential consequences for mental health and social development in teens and children.

cards.title: What Stressed Teens Need During College Season
cards.body: When your teen is stressed about college applications, the answer isn't more advice. Asking one thoughtful question and listening carefully can make the real difference in supporting them.

cards.title: Campus Sexual Assault: Parent Talk Guide
cards.body: Parents can maintain open dialogue with college-bound children about sexual safety on campus. Encouraging colleges to implement programs helps create safer environments and end campus sexual violence.

cards.title: Family Blame Patterns Shape Self-Perception
cards.body: If you were blamed for your family's problems as a child, you may have been the 'identified patient.' Learning it wasn't your fault can transform how you see yourself.

cards.title: Child Dies Weeks After Waterford Arson Attack
cards.body: A 6-year-old child has died weeks following an arson attack at their family home in Waterford, Republic of Ireland. The incident occurred last month in the family's residence on the outskirts of the city.
